subject: [hw] DONE DEC03 rev 4: LAT fetch-ready latch fix; N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2789/2789
body:
DONE DEC03 rev 4. Small but important follow-up to rev 3 after reading the DEC02 LAT trace: the trace writes LAT_VLD 0x11108 = 0x101 (latch), 0x11140 = 0x100000, 0x110ec = 0x10000000, 0x110b4/0x110b8/0x110b0 (vfifo/rptr), but never writes LAT_VLD 0x1108c = 0x100000. The rev-3 model only set fetch-ready on 0x23 bit 20, so a HEVC frame poll of LAT_VLD +0xe8 could stall again. A latched reader now counts as fetch-ready too; that is [I] and documented in REGISTERS.md (0x3a row, section 5). A test programs LAT in the trace order and checks +0xe8 without the 0x8c write.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/run_tests.sh
  -> N2VLD checks 916 pass 916 (x2), N2VLDV checks 478 pass 478 (x2), arm64 iOS compile ok
  -> N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2789/2789
Optional oracle still N2TEST DEC03-oracle PASS 12/12.

Everything else from rev 3 stands, including the not-done list: T02 hook not landed (exact text posted), LAT vs core is [I], no decode completion, VLD pointer units [I], EPB edge cases, no phone, no publish. Files unchanged except n2vld.c/t_vld.c/REGISTERS.md/STATUS.md.
